watch_items.text: Cash liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2025}} and the weakest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2025}}).

Maturities: debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, against cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2025}}, so part of the near-term maturities needs refinancing.

Cash flow after leases: FCF after leases of {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}} is only {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}} of debt, leaving little headroom while net capex of {{net_capex@FY2025}} stays high.

Leverage: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}} and the highest of the group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}), so the ratio remains the main constraint on the credit profile.
